moves.name: Wall Push-Up
moves.summary: Hands on a wall, body in a straight line, bend the elbows and press back.
cues: Hands a little wider than shoulders
moves.breathing: Inhale as you bend, exhale as you press.

moves.name: Incline Push-Up
moves.summary: Hands on a sturdy raised surface, body straight, lower the chest and press away.
cues: Step feet back until the body is one line

moves.name: Knee Push-Up
moves.summary: Knees down, hands under shoulders, lower and press while the torso stays rigid.
cues: Knees, hips, and shoulders line up
Full elbow bend you can control

moves.name: Push-Up
moves.summary: Hands under shoulders, toes planted, lower the chest and press the floor away.

moves.name: Wide Push-Up
moves.summary: Hands set wider than the shoulders to bias the chest, then press with a straight body.
cues: Do not let the hips drop
mistakes: Hands so wide the shoulders pinch
moves.breathing: Exhale as the chest leaves the floor.

moves.name: Diamond Push-Up
moves.summary: Hands close under the chest so thumbs and fingers form a diamond, then press.
cues: Stop if the wrists complain and widen slightly

moves.name: Decline Push-Up
moves.summary: Feet raised on a low step, hands on the floor, press with the shoulders carrying more load.
cues: Step only as high as you can keep a straight line

moves.name: Archer Push-Up
moves.summary: One arm bends while the other stays straighter, then switch, like drawing a bow.
cues: Shift the chest toward the bending arm
moves.breathing: Exhale as you press back to center.

moves.name: Pike Push-Up
moves.summary: Hips high, body in a pike, bend the elbows so the head travels toward the floor, then press.
moves.breathing: Inhale to lower, exhale to press.

moves.name: Pseudo-Planche Push-Up
moves.summary: Hands by the hips, fingers forward or slightly out, lean until the shoulders pass the wrists, then bend and press.

moves.name: Bench Dip
moves.summary: Hands on a sturdy seat behind you, feet forward, bend the elbows and press.
cues: Stop if the front of the shoulder pinches

moves.name: Parallel Bar Dip
moves.summary: Support yourself on bars, lower until the shoulders stay comfortable, then press tall.

moves.name: Scapular Pull
moves.summary: Hang and lift the shoulders away from the ears without bending the elbows, then lower.
moves.breathing: Exhale as the shoulders set down.

moves.name: Dead Hang
moves.summary: Hang from a bar with a grip you can hold, ribs quiet, shoulders active enough to feel safe.
moves.breathing: Slow nasal breaths for the whole hold.

moves.name: Australian Row
moves.summary: Body straight under a low bar, pull the chest toward the bar, then lower.
cues: Straight line from heel to head

moves.name: Towel Row
moves.summary: A towel looped on a closed door, lean back, and pull the chest toward the door.
cues: Test the door before you lean

moves.name: Negative Pull-Up
moves.summary: Start with the chin over the bar and lower yourself as slowly as you can.
cues: Jump or step to the top
Three to five slow seconds down
moves.breathing: Exhale on the way down or breathe quietly through it.

moves.name: Pull-Up
moves.summary: Hang, pull until the chin clears the bar, lower with control.

moves.name: Chin-Up
moves.summary: Palms face you, pull the chin over the bar, lower until the arms are long.

moves.name: Wide Pull-Up
moves.summary: A wider grip shifts work toward the upper back. Pull the chest toward the bar.
cues: Do not go so wide the shoulders pinch

moves.name: L-Sit Pull-Up
moves.summary: Hold the legs forward in an L, or tuck them, and pull the chin over the bar.
cues: Legs only as high as the back stays honest
moves.breathing: Brace, then exhale on the pull.

moves.name: Band Pull-Apart
moves.summary: Hold a band at shoulder height and pull the hands apart until the band touches the chest.
cues: Pause when the band meets the chest
mistakes: Using a band you cannot finish

moves.name: Bodyweight Squat
moves.summary: Feet planted, sit the hips back and down, then stand tall.

moves.name: Jump Squat
moves.summary: Squat, then jump, and land softly back into the next squat.
cues: Stand tall before you leave the floor
moves.breathing: Exhale as you leave the floor.

moves.name: Split Squat
moves.summary: One foot forward, one back, lower the rear knee, then press through the front foot.

moves.name: Reverse Lunge
moves.summary: Step backward, lower, and return to stand. Switch sides.
cues: Step long enough to stay balanced

moves.name: Glute Bridge
moves.summary: On your back, feet flat, press the hips up and squeeze, then lower.

moves.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
moves.summary: Bridge on one foot, the other leg long, hips level.

moves.name: Step-Up
moves.summary: Step onto a sturdy low platform and stand tall, then lower.
mistakes: Pushing off the back leg only

moves.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
moves.summary: Rear foot elevated, lower the back knee, press through the front heel.
cues: Shorten the stance if the knee hurts

moves.name: Wall Sit
moves.summary: Back on a wall, thighs near level, hold.
mistakes: Knees past the toes if it hurts
moves.breathing: Quiet breaths for the whole hold.

moves.name: Calf Raise
moves.summary: Rise onto the balls of the feet, pause, and lower.
cues: Straight knees if that is the goal
Use a wall for balance if needed

moves.name: Assisted Pistol Squat
moves.summary: Hold a door frame, squat on one leg as deep as you can own, then stand.
cues: Use the hands only as much as you need

moves.name: Pistol Squat
moves.summary: Squat on one leg to a depth you control and stand without the other foot touching.

moves.name: Plank
moves.summary: Forearms or hands down, body one line, hold.

moves.name: Side Plank
moves.summary: On one forearm, hips lifted, body straight from ear to ankle.
moves.breathing: Breathe into the side that is working.

moves.name: Dead Bug
moves.summary: On your back, arms and knees up, reach the opposite arm and leg away while the low back stays down.
cues: Exhale as the limbs go long
Range only as far as the back stays quiet

moves.name: Bird Dog
moves.summary: On hands and knees, reach one arm and the opposite leg, then switch.

moves.name: Hollow Hold
moves.summary: On your back, low back pressed down, arms and legs long and slightly off the floor.
cues: Scale the legs higher if needed

moves.name: Hollow Rock
moves.summary: From a hollow shape, rock a short distance without losing the low back.

moves.name: Lying Leg Raise
moves.summary: On your back, lift straight legs and lower them without the back arching.
cues: Hands can pin the hips lightly

moves.name: Hanging Knee Raise
moves.summary: Hang, lift the knees, lower without swinging.
mistakes: Only bending the hips a little

moves.name: Hanging Leg Raise
moves.summary: Hang and lift straight legs as high as the back stays honest.
cues: Bend knees if the shape breaks

moves.name: L-Sit Tuck
moves.summary: Hands on the floor or low bars, knees tucked, hips lifted, hold.

moves.name: L-Sit
moves.summary: Hands down, legs straight forward, hips off the floor.
cues: Point or flex the feet consistently
Use a tuck if the legs drop

moves.name: Mountain Climbers
moves.summary: From a plank, drive one knee in, then the other, at a pace you can keep honest.
moves.breathing: Match breath to a steady count.

moves.name: Frog Stand
moves.summary: Squat, place hands, rest knees on the arms, and lean until the feet hover.
moves.breathing: Hold a breath pattern, do not gasp.

moves.name: Crow Pose
moves.summary: Knees high on the arms, lean, and lift the feet.

moves.name: Wall Handstand Hold
moves.summary: Kick or walk up a wall and hold a straight line as well as you can.

moves.name: Chest-to-Wall Handstand
moves.summary: Face the wall, hands close, walk the feet up until the chest is near the wall.

moves.name: Handstand Shoulder Taps
moves.summary: In a wall handstand, shift and tap one shoulder, then the other.
cues: Keep the hips over the hands

moves.name: Tuck Planche Lean
moves.summary: Hands by the hips, lean forward with knees tucked until the feet lighten.

moves.name: Cat-Cow
moves.summary: On hands and knees, round the spine, then gently extend, moving with the breath.
moves.breathing: Inhale to open, exhale to round.

moves.name: World's Greatest Stretch
moves.summary: From a lunge, place a hand inside the front foot, rotate the chest open, then switch.
cues: Back knee down if you need it

moves.name: 90/90 Hip Switch
moves.summary: Sit with both knees bent near ninety degrees and rotate the legs to the other side.

moves.name: Thoracic Rotation
moves.summary: Side-lying or hands and knees, rotate the upper back while the hips stay quieter.
cues: Follow the hand with the eyes

moves.name: Deep Squat Hold
moves.summary: Sit into a deep squat you can breathe in, heels down or supported.
cues: Hold a rail if the heels rise and that bothers you

moves.name: Hamstring Stretch
moves.summary: One leg long, hinge until you feel the back of the thigh, and breathe.
mistakes: Rounding hard to chase the toes

moves.name: Child's Pose
moves.summary: Knees apart or together, hips toward the heels, arms long, breathe into the back.
cues: Stay only as long as it feels kind

moves.name: Shoulder Circles
moves.summary: Stand or sit and draw slow circles with the shoulders, both directions.
moves.breathing: Match one breath to a few circles.

programs.name: Foundations
programs.summary: Four weeks, three days, a full body start for new trainees.

programs.name: Push-Up Ladder
programs.summary: Thirty short days that raise pushing volume a little at a time.

programs.name: Pull-Up Path
programs.summary: Six weeks, three days, from hangs toward stricter pulls. Needs a bar.

programs.name: Core 21
programs.summary: Twenty-one short days for bracing and control.

programs.name: Mobility Reset
programs.summary: Fourteen days, about ten minutes, to keep joints moving.

paths.name: Push
paths.summary: From incline presses toward a leaning planche push-up.

nodes.title: Push-Up
nodes.how: Log 15 push-ups with a straight body.

nodes.title: Archer Push-Up
nodes.how: Log 6 each side. Enter the weaker side.

paths.name: Pull
paths.summary: From a hang toward an L-sit pull-up.

nodes.title: Dead Hang
nodes.how: Hold a dead hang for 45 seconds.

nodes.title: L-Sit Pull-Up
nodes.how: Log 5 pull-ups with the legs forward or tucked.

paths.name: Legs
paths.summary: From squats toward a pistol squat.

nodes.title: Split Squat
nodes.how: Log 12 each side. Enter the weaker side.

paths.name: Core
paths.summary: From a plank toward an L-sit.

nodes.title: Hollow Hold
nodes.how: Hold a hollow shape for 30 seconds.

nodes.title: L-Sit Tuck
nodes.how: Hold a tuck L-sit for 15 seconds.

paths.name: Balance
paths.summary: From a frog stand toward a freestanding handstand.

nodes.title: Frog Stand
nodes.how: Hold a frog stand for 20 seconds.

nodes.title: Wall Handstand
nodes.how: Hold a wall handstand for 30 seconds.

nodes.title: Freestanding Handstand
nodes.how: Hold away from the wall for 5 seconds. Log that hold.

paths.name: Flow
paths.summary: Unlocks from the number of mobility sessions you finish.

badges.title: Path complete
badges.detail: Finish every node on one path.

badges.title: Early session
badges.detail: Finish a session before 8 in the morning.

badges.title: Late session
badges.detail: Finish a session after 9 at night.

badges.title: Five ghosts
badges.detail: Beat your weekly ghost five times.

badges.title: Perfect week
badges.detail: Finish every planned training day in a week.

The charge stays alive when you train.
Your ghost is only your own best week.
Rest is planned. Other days ask for a session.
Log the work you already did if it lasted 10 minutes.
Skill tests are waiting when you want them.
The altitude map moves when the work is real.
One more session keeps the week honest.
Mobility counts on a rest day.
Beat yesterday's effort, not a stranger.
The ring fills when the day is counted.
